concept: Glue: serverless Spark ETL with crawlers and Data Catalog
tests: Choosing a serverless service for large ETL jobs that discovers schemas itself and runs Spark without clusters.
expected: AWS Glue — crawlers build the Data Catalog, managed Spark jobs with no provisioning. Triggers: "serverless ETL", "discovers schemas", "Spark-based transformations", "without provisioning clusters".
why_not: EMR requires managing a cluster; Athena — interactive queries, not heavy transformations; Data Pipeline — orchestration on top of separate compute.
